name: Ceretas Limited
summary: Ceretas Limited is a medical technology company, incorporated in 2024, developing a portable, non-invasive therapeutic ultrasound platform for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative conditions. The platform works through neuromodulation using focused ultrasound to stimulate neural circuits, and through temporary, reversible opening of the blood-brain barrier with ultrasound and microbubbles, aiding clearance of amyloid-beta and tau and drug delivery to targeted brain regions.
